messages:
deploy-bot: [orchestrator] initiating staged rollout to 'staging' for tag v2.8.5-rc5 (commit 9a3f7b2). Targets: hydra-staging pool (12 pods). Change window: 2026-03-20T14:00Z->2026-03-20T16:00Z. Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Runbook: infra/playbooks/staging-rollout.md :rocket:

alice: initiating canary now. i'll watch smoke and logs. @carla can you keep an eye on latency SLOs?

carla: watching p50/p95 and 5xxs. will alert if p50 > 100ms or error rate > 0.5% :eyes:

deploy-bot: canary step 1 (5%) started. instances replaced: 1/12. running preflight checks and ci smoke.

frank: kicking off smoke suite: `make smoke-test TARGET=staging`

frank: smoke results: mostly OK, reranker-rank smoke failing 1/20. capturing logs now.

bob: what does the failure look like? stack? any exceptions?

frank: error snippet from logs: `IndexOutOfRangeError at reranker.score (reranker.py:214)` — full log: https://logs.example.com/9a3f7b2 :link:

dan: quick check — looks like a quantization-flag mismatch between new model binary and serving config. could be fixed by pinning the reranker model to last known-good variant.

alice: agree. pin reranker route and pause canary progression until we confirm. @deploy-bot hold progression.

deploy-bot: hold acknowledged. canary progression paused at 5%. actions applied: pinned /models/reranker -> v2.8.4-quantfix. infra notified.

carla: after pin applied, error rate dropped from 0.9% -> 0.12%, latency back within expected. :thumbsup:

alice: thanks. proceeding to continue canary to 25% in 3 minutes. everyone ready?

deploy-bot: canary step 2 starting -> 25%. replaced instances: 3/12. rolling health checks in progress.

erin: product note: feature flag tied to this deploy remains off by default; no customer-facing change in this window.

deploy-bot: final rollout to 100% initiated. post-deploy smoke and e2e in flight.

deploy-bot: deployment complete for tag v2.8.5-rc5 to staging. summary: 12/12 pods updated, 0 rollbacks, healthgate: pass. pinned route: /models/reranker -> v2.8.4-quantfix. notes: one flaky reranker smoke fixed by pin; will schedule model onboarding fix and follow-up. CI artifacts: https://ci.example.com/build/5234 :white_check_mark:

alice: good run. i'll open a follow-up ticket to track permanent reranker fix (refs INC-287).

carla: added a dashboard alert for reranker error spikes (threshold 0.5%).

bob: marking this rollout as completed in the release calendar and adding a short note about the temporary pin.

frank: leaving smoke logs and artifacts here: https://artifacts.example.com/5234/smoke.zip

alice: thanks all — closing thread.
